Environment Variables Changed

Application initialization can be complex and require a long time to complete after the restart. *IIS Application Initialization* module was built to handle the needs of gracefully recycling worker processes within a single IIS server. In additonal to decreasing the response time for first requests by pre-loading worker processes it also enables you to enhance the user experience during initialization by redirecting a request to static pages, such as a placeholder or splash screen. The overall Azure App Service has been integrated with *IIS Application Initialization*. In addtional to the above features within a single server it is designed to understand an application's initialization behavior and route traffic with awareness of warm and cold instances. It is **recommended** that you use the **Application Initialization** feature and ensure you are scaled to **multiple workers** to enhance the user experience while the Application is warming up. For more details, please refer to: * The Ultimate Guide to Running Healthy Apps in the Cloud
